text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early in the morning, when I stopped by 
the training course under maintenance on 
some business……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLATTER-CLATTER-CLATTER――putter...!)

text_block_list.name: Mechanic A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Is it broken? The track leveler 
suddenly stopped moving...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, still undergoing maintenance? Did 
something happen, by any chance~?
choice_data_list: Looks like there was some trouble.
Looks like there was some trouble.

text_block_list.name: Mechanic A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so sorry about this! The track 
smoother suddenly broke down on us... 
We'll have it fixed right away!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Nope, I'm totally fine~♪ I can wait as 
long as it takes~

text_block_list.name: Mechanic B
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be faster to just call a 
professional?

text_block_list.name: Mechanic A
text_block_list.text:
It's morning rush hour right now, you 
know? There's no telling when it'll 
arrive.

text_block_list.name: Mechanic B
text_block_list.text:
Still, can the two of us fix it right 
away...?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's all good~! We've still got plenty of 
time!☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's calm down and tackle them one by 
one, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Mechanic B
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yeah, you're right. First we move the 
turf roller out of the way, and then we 
continue leveling the ground...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll help too! We just gotta get that car 
off the track, right~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Or would it be better if I helped smooth 
out the track~?

text_block_list.name: Mechanic A
text_block_list.text:
Huh! I appreciate the thought, but having 
a student do something like that is...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, it's okay if I help out, right? 
Which one do you think is better~?
choice_data_list: Can you push and move the ground roller?
Please run the track to level the ground!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Roger that☆ All righty! I'll dodge it in 
no time~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Heeeeeave-hooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To prevent damaging the turf, an iron 
plate was slipped under the roller. She 
threw all her weight into pushing the 
heavy roller forward...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Nnnngh...! It's so... heavy...! Just... 
one... more pushhh...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Pheeew~! I somehow carried it all~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono hauled the ground-leveler 
off the track, allowing the maintenance to 
be finished right on time.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Okaay! I'll wrap this up in no time, leave 
it to me~☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Tooooooooh~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono carried the large harrow 
detached from the ground-leveler vehicle 
and ran across the dirt track.

text_block_list.name: Mechanic B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Look at that speed...! Isn't she 
faster than the ground leveler 
vehicle...?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Maintenance complete! ☆ What a relief, we 
finished properly before the other girls 
arrived! ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While Hishi Akebono was leveling the 
track, the ground-leveler vehicle was 
repaired and returned to the garage. And 
so, the maintenance was successfully 
completed.
